title: Dungeon Odyssey
description: The descendants of humanity who were born in labyrinths and raised on the milk of monsters developed extraordinary physical abilities. Known as dungeon babies, they eventually returned to the surface. Kim Jinwoo was born in the deepest part of the labyrinth and spent his life as an ordinary guide, suppressing his instincts and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong, he unexpectedly becomes the owner of a labyrinth. From the lowest-ranking excavator to the king of the dungeon, Kim Jinwoo's journey begins.
author: Glumph / Son Min-woo
